headline: Sunderland Bank The Sheet, 123 Cash It
deck: Sunderland's clean sheet feeds a stack of defenders, with 123 doubling up on it
body:
One goal, one clean sheet, and the Sunderland back line paid out across half the league. Reinildo and Hume both went 90 minutes for six apiece, and 123 banked twelve from the pair alone. Sits 76 to 35 over test31121, whose Berge managed two off the bench at Fulham. That one is all but done.

test211 rode the same wall. Roefs kept his sheet for six, Castagne added six more off 67 minutes, King chipped in two. Forty to 48 down against test1, so the clean sheet keeps it live rather than winning it.

test4 got the goal that mattered. Isidor on for 26 minutes and off the mark, five points from almost nothing, with E.Le Fée adding three on the sheet. Fifty-six to 45 over testf, whose men were all on the wrong end of it: Ballard and Xhaka held their clean sheet for six and three, N.Angulo blanked on a two. Leno's three saves earned test3331 three, but a keeper conceding once doesn't move the needle against test2.
